candidate_edge: H-V4 revision 2: NY pre-open session-range breakout on USDJPY (primary) and EURUSD (secondary). Frozen 13213 mechanics on a 60-minute bar grid aligned to :30 server time built from shift-1 pairs of completed M30 bars (chart/set timeframe M30, QM_IsNewBar(PERIOD_M30) gate; day rejected if any required half-bar is missing): range = the N completed grid bars ending 15:30 server (= 08:30 America/New_York; N=2 -> arm C2 primary, N=3 -> arm C3 second frozen arm; EURUSD C3 only), buy stop at range high / sell stop at range low (OCO, both send results retained, one-sided day = cancel and no trade) at the first eligible tick in [15:30, 16:30) server (framework PRE30_POST30 high-impact blackout; no placement at or after 16:30), SL = opposite edge (stop distance W), no TP, skip when W < 0.4 x ATR(14, same grid) or W > 2.5 x ATR, trail SL to the min/max of the last two completed grid bars once open profit >= 1.0 x the CURRENT stop distance (incumbent 13213 behaviour), flat at the first tick at or after 23:00 server (= 16:00 New York; also after a holiday gap), framework Friday close 21:00 server unchanged. One position per symbol per day. Server = America/New_York + 7 h is valid for the Darwinex clock only; an FTMO build derives both times via the governed QM_SessionClock helper. Bounded integer/double inputs only; no ML.
confidence: Moderate for the ABSOLUTE USDJPY edge, low-to-moderate for the replacement claim. Absolute: (1) the mechanism is tester-qualified on the symbol (13213 through Q14), (2) the harness is reconciled against that tester result on the control cell (+1.8 % trades, +0.018R; A3 only), (3) all nine USDJPY cells are positive on the selection period and eight of nine survive validation, (4) the unadjusted 20-bd block intervals for SEL R/bd exclude zero for C2 and C3. Replacement of the 13213 window: after the critic's paired, dependence-preserving comparison against A3 with a max-of-8 correction the uplift is NOT significant (C2-A3 SEL +0.066 R/bd, 95 % [-0.030, +0.160], p=0.164); it is carried as a pre-registered hypothesis with its own Q02 test (criterion 8). The +0.02R harness optimism is an A3-only planning heuristic; arm-specific tester gaps are established only by the Q02 canary. EURUSD C3 is a marginal secondary finding (intervals touch zero in both periods). Not modelled: real-tick intra-minute paths, spread and slippage (tester Model 4), the news blackout on exits/trailing; the harness deviates from the frozen contract on M30 completeness (5 days), news retry resolution and holiday-gap exit (one trade per arm) - none sign-flipping per the critic's sensitivities.
confounders: Multiplicity: 314 cells were evaluated; 27 SEL passes vs 17.4 expected and 13 survivors vs 5.5 expected by the per-cell null, which ignores dependence between cells of one symbol (8 of the 13 survivors are USDJPY). The critic's paired within-USDJPY test (5,000 circular 20-bd blocks, max-of-8) does not establish C2/C3 as a significant improvement over A3; the replacement claim is a hypothesis (criterion 8), the absolute edge is what the canary tests.

Same-symbol overlap with the incumbent QM5_13213 (Tokyo window): the NY pre-open trade often follows a Tokyo-range trade on the same day; H-V4 is a candidate REPLACEMENT/upgrade of the 13213 window rather than an additional independent sleeve unless the daily-P/L correlation with 13213 measures below 0.5 at Q08 (pre-registered tail test).

Harness optimism: zero-spread, zero-slippage fills at the level and 18 simulation-only days on the control cell put the harness ~+0.02R above the tester on A3; this is an A3-only heuristic, the arm-specific gap is unknown until Q02.

News blackout overlap: the 08:30 New York anchor coincides with the densest US high-impact release slot; the harness models PRE30_POST30 at placement with a one-hour minute-resolution retry (280 delayed / 91 blocked placement days over 2018-25 for USDJPY C2); the frozen EA contract retries on the M30 bar open within [15:30, 16:30). The critic's strict no-retry sensitivity still clears every bar.

Regime: 2021-2022 (JPY depreciation, Fed hiking) contribute 90.6R of the 141.1R SEL net for USDJPY C2 (2018 +24.8, 2019 +12.0, 2020 +13.7, 2021 +51.8, 2022 +38.8), and 2024 contributes 59.2R of the 91.0R VAL net; every SEL and VAL year is nevertheless positive.
Drawdown at the bar: the USDJPY C2 validation worst-year drawdown is exactly 25.04R against the 25R Q05 bar; C3 (22.20R) is the pre-registered fallback arm.
Friday close: 92 of the 998 SEL trades exit at the framework Friday close (21:00 server) before the 23:00 flat; a different Friday policy changes the numbers.
Universe: the registration miscounted the FX universe (33 claimed, 28 exist); the harness enumerated all 36 registered symbols that exist; research_trial_count = 314 is unchanged.

Selection 2018-07-02..2022-12-30, validation 2023-01-02..2025-12-31, floor/cap and rule frozen before the run. 27 of 314 cells pass the SEL rule (17.4 expected by the per-cell centred block-bootstrap null), 13 survive VAL confirmation (5.5 expected), all 13 family-consistent. USDJPY: 9/9 cells SEL-positive, 8/9 survivors (B2 fails VAL at -0.0006R); C2 is the best cell in the whole grid (SEL n=998, 0.85/bd, +0.141R, PF 1.302, worst-year DD 20.8R, +0.120 R/bd; VAL n=632, 0.81/bd, +0.144R, PF 1.295, DD 25.0R, +0.116 R/bd; chance-pass probability joint 0.0135). EURUSD: A and B anchors negative on SEL (all six cells), C2/C3/C4 positive on SEL and VAL; C2 fails only the 25R DD bar (27.5R), C3 and C4 are survivors. Indices, EUR/CHF/CAD crosses, AUDNZD, GBPNZD negative everywhere; XAUUSD C cells positive only in 2023-25 (not selectable).
proposed_mechanism: USDJPY's intraday information flow is concentrated around the 08:30 New York macro-release / pre-open hour (US data prints, Treasury-yield repricing, the JPY carry-book adjustment into the US session). A completed 2-3 hour range immediately before that anchor bounds the pre-release consolidation; a stop-order breakout of that range at the anchor converts the release into a directional trade with a stop equal to the range width and no fixed target, exactly the risk geometry that already qualified on USDJPY at the Tokyo window (QM5_13213, Q02..Q14). The sweep shows the anchor, not the mechanism, was the limiting factor: every USDJPY cell of the family is positive on the selection period (9/9), and the NY pre-open cells roughly double R per business day at equal density. On EURUSD the same NY anchor is the ONLY positive anchor (A and B cells are all negative on SEL), consistent with the pair's US-session macro sensitivity rather than a London-open microstructure effect (the H-V1 result).
